siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Dal Pescatore
siblings.summary: No hotel sits within true walking distance of Dal Pescatore — Hotel Airone is the closest bed at ~1.6 km, and 9 Muse runs the shuttle that compensates.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Dal Pescatore
siblings.summary: Seven character stays around the Runate hamlet that holds Dal Pescatore — sorted by distance, building, and who you'd be staying with.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Dal Pescatore
siblings.summary: A weekend planner anchored at Dal Pescatore in Runate: Sabbioneta as the only true in-radius UNESCO target, Mantua and Cremona as borderline-but-essential stretch trips, plus Le Bine wetlands, Asola, Casalmaggiore and the Grana Padano dairies in between.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Dal Pescatore
siblings.summary: The 30 km circle around Dal Pescatore catches almost no IT conferences — Cremona sits on the boundary and is the only realistic hub; serious dev events require driving to Milan.
